handback.t:
## Final light pass: all 5 items pass, no new defects

I worked under the same rules: copies and synthetic roots only, no edits, no real learner run. The real `events.db` sha256 is unchanged.

| # | Item | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cold concurrent `start` stress | PASS | 12 trials of 4 simultaneous starts, each on a fresh data dir. Every trial gave exactly 1 `started:true` and 3 "already running", with 0 `ok:false` and no error output. My harness counted `ok:false` rather than exit codes; the CLI only sets exit 1 alongside `ok:false`, so all exits were 0. The earlier "no such table: control" failure (2 of 10 trials last round) did not occur. |
| 2 | Stops during a long stage | PASS | 3 aborted attempts followed by a healthy run gave `slow:kept:finally ran`, with attempts counted as 1. The stage now runs instead of being skipped. |
| 2 | Explicit `failed` result | PASS | Recorded once (attempts = 1) with its own reason `nope`, and not retried. |
| 2 | Everything else re-run | PASS | Stages that throw are still contained: recorded `failed` after 3 attempts and the cycle completes. Dependency-skip still works, and the process-killing stage is still `skipped` after 3 attempts with no crash loop. The pruned cycle observation is still not emitted again. |
| 3 | `nm_guarded` temp-file cleanup | PASS | A 60 s old temp named with a live pid was kept. Old temps of dead pids, including the 3 left by hard kills, were removed. A fresh temp (under 2 s) and a non-numeric name were kept. Two fresh states are still byte-identical. |
| 4 | neural-mesh gate (G1–G4, G6), my own run | PASS | G1: 575 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored; no baseline test is missing and the 8 added tests are all `nm_guarded` ones (including the new live-pid temp test). G2/G6: 0 differences out of 36,449 values in each of 31-60 and 61-90. G3: 47 tests OK. G4: output and `r102_ledger.json` byte-identical to baseline. |
| 4 | neural-mesh git state | PASS | HEAD `0d3b505`, tracked-diff sha256 equals the baseline (`5d36f1fd…`). Status is the baseline plus `src/bin/nm_guarded.rs` and `tests/nm_guarded.rs` only. |
| 5 | rGi typecheck, suite, tracked diff | PASS | `tsc --noEmit` exits 0. Full suite: 124 tests, 123 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped (the opt-in test). Tracked `git diff` is empty. |
| 5 | Leftover processes | PASS | 0 `hebbwise-learn`, `nm_guarded` or `neural-mesh` processes remain after all runs. That includes the worker previously leaked by the builder's race test. |

One design note, not a defect: stages that throw are still retried up to 3 times by default. Only an explicit `failed` result is final on the first attempt.
